newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Two Palestinians, wounded last week, die.
newsitem.headline: Two Palestinians, wounded last week, die.

text.p: Two Palestinians, one a nine-year-old boy, wounded in gun battles with Israeli troops last week have died, raising to 72 the number of Arabs and Jews killed in the clashes, Palestinian hospital officials said on Tuesday.
The officials in the Gaza Strip said the two, Tamer al-Masri, 9, and Mohammed Shalyel, 25, a Palestinian policeman, were both wounded on Thursday, the bloodiest of four days of clashes.
Fifteen Israeli soldiers were killed in the fighting sparked by Israel's opening last Tuesday of a tourist tunnel near Moslem holy places in Jerusalem.
